summary: iter-397 Hybrid multi-implant mechanism: backend + frontend E2E verified. Backend pytest 10/10 passing (patient-lookup role gating, case-insensitive match, drafts/archived excluded, unknown-reg found=false, nurse 403; patient-history returns cases with is_current flag & 404 on unknown id; POST /procedures and POST /procedures/augmentation-case persist linked_parent_case_id). [data-testid=existing-patient-autofill-btn] click populated Patient Name='P2 Aug UI Patient' and Age='48' (profession/mobile empty because source case values are empty — correct). To validate the multi-case strip I created a linked draft via API and opened /procedures/{new_id} — [data-testid=patient-history-strip] rendered 'Patient Treatment History (2 cases)' with 2 tappable rows and exactly one 'This case' badge on the current one.
